title: Ilimin sinadaran da ke cikin kayan ruwa

say: Ilimin Sinadaran da ke Cikin Kayan Ruwa. Wannan shi ne babi na 1 na kwas ɗin.
Abubuwa uku tukuna: wane surfactant ke yin wane aiki, yadda pH ke aiki, da yadda za ki hana ƙwayoyin cuta shiga.

shots.label: Surfactant ana juya shi cikin ruwa
say: Dubi wannan bokitin. Muna juya surfactant, wato sinadarin da ke yin kumfa yana wanke datti, cikin ruwa, a hankali.
Kowace ƙwayar surfactant tana da kai mai son ruwa da wutsiya mai son mai.
Wutsiyoyin suna taruwa su zama ƙananan ƙwallaye da ake kira micelles. Maiko yana shiga ciki, kuma ruwan kurkurawa yana ɗauke shi.

shots.label: Rukunan surfactant guda huɗu

card.title: Rukunai huɗu
card.note: An raba su bisa cajin da ke kansu

say: A wannan shiryayye an raba su bisa cajin da ke kansu.
Anionic kamar SLES suna wankewa suna yin kumfa. CAPB yana sa su yi laushi. Nonionic suna yanke maiko. Cationic suna kashe ƙwayoyin cuta, suna gyara gashi, suna kuma sa kaya laushi.

shots.label: Mai laushin kaya (cationic)
shots.banner: Kada ki haɗa sabulun anionic da cationic
say: Wannan ruwa mai kama da madara shi ne mai laushin kaya, wato softener, kayan cationic ne.
Surfactant na anionic da na cationic suna jan juna, su daskare su zama abu mai ɗanko wanda ba ya yin ko ɗaya daga cikin ayyukan.
Shi ya sa ake saka softener a ruwan kurkurawa, ba tare da sabulun wanki ba.

shots.label: Kwaɓin SLES, kusan 70% mai aiki
say: Ki kalli ma'aunin yayin da muke ɗebo kwaɓin SLES. Yawanci kusan 70% ne mai aiki, don haka giram 100 yana ɗauke da kusan giram 70 na surfactant na gaske.
CAPB yawanci kusan 30% ne mai aiki. Kullum ki karanta takardar bayanin mai sayar miki, saboda adadin yana canzawa.

card.title: Gwajin sabulun hannu na Bisi, 5 kg

say: Ga lissafin Bisi. Sinadari mai aiki shi ne kashin da kika yi amfani da shi sau ƙarfinsa, a haɗa duka.
Tsarinta 12.3% ne mai aiki, giram 615 na surfactant na gaske a kilogiram 5.
Lokacin da sabon SLES ɗinta ya zama 60% kawai mai aiki, ta yi amfani da giram 875 maimakon giram 750 don ƙarfin ya zama ɗaya.

shots.label: Takardar gwajin pH (universal)
say: Wannan takarda tana karanta pH, wato ƙarfin tsami ko kaifi, daga 0 zuwa 14. Ruwa 7 ne. Ƙasa da shi tsami ne, sama da shi kaifi ne, kuma kowane mataki ya fi na baya ƙarfi sau goma.
Ki tsoma, ki jira lokacin da ke kan fakitin, ki kwatanta launin a hasken rana. Ki yi gwaji kafin ki zuba launi.

shots.label: Safar hannu da gilashin ido
shots.banner: Ki zuba asid ko kostik a hankali CIKIN ruwa
say: Kafin ki haɗa kowane ruwan daidaitawa, ki saka safar hannu da gilashin kariya.
Ki zuba asid ko kostik a hankali cikin ruwa, kada ki taɓa zuba ruwa a kan sinadarin, saboda zai iya yin zafi ya fantsama. Ki rubuta suna a kowace kwalbar daidaitawa.

shots.label: Samfurin 200 g a kofi mai tsabta

card.title: Shamfun Amaka na 20 kg
card.note: A daidaita samfur tukuna, sannan haɗin duka

say: Amaka ta auna samfurin giram 200, wato 1% na haɗinta, ta zuba ruwan citric acid ɗigo-ɗigo har ya nuna pH 6. Hakan ya ɗauki giram 0.9.
Sau 100 ya ba da giram 90. Ta zuba giram 72 tukuna, ta gwada, sannan sauran a hankali, don kada ta wuce iyaka.

shots.label: Maganin ban ɗaki da bilicin
say: Idan kina gwada kaya a gida, ki raba maganin wanke ban ɗaki da bilicin, kamar waɗannan kwalabe biyu.

shots.label: Ruwan da aka tafasa aka sanyaya
say: Sabulun ruwa galibi ruwa ne, kuma ruwa yana ciyar da ƙwayoyin cuta. Don haka ki yi amfani da ruwan da aka tace, ko ruwan da aka tafasa aka sanyaya a rufe.
Ki wanke ganguna da muciyoyi, ki kurkura, ki goge da alcohol 70%, ki bar su su bushe. Kada ki taɓa amfani da su don abinci.

shots.label: Preservative (haɗin phenoxyethanol)
say: Preservative, wato maganin hana lalacewa, yana hana ƙwayoyin cuta da ke shigowa daga baya. Hauwa ta tabbata pH ɗinta yana cikin iyakar mai sayarwa, sannan ta auna giram 200 a ma'aunin dijital.
Ki zuba shi ƙasa da kusan digiri 40 na Celsius, saboda zafi yana iya lalata wasu preservative. Kuma ki guji formalin: guba ne.

shots.label: Sababbin kwalabe, masu tsabta
say: Yanzu ki zuba a sababbin kwalabe ko waɗanda aka tsabtace, sannan ki rufe ki liƙa rubutu da sauri.

shots.label: Samfuran ajiya: ɗaki da wuri mai ɗumi
say: Ki ajiye kwalabe biyu daga kowane haɗi, ɗaya a yanayin ɗaki, ɗaya a wuri mai ɗumi.
Ki duba su kowane mako na mako huɗu, sannan kowane wata: ƙamshi, launi, haske, kauri, pH da kumburi.

shots.label: Kwalbar wanke ido mai ruwa mai tsabta
say: Ki karanta Safety Data Sheet, wato takardar bayanin tsaro, ta kowane sinadari. Ki saka safar hannu ta nitrile da gilashin kariya, ki bar iska ta shiga, ki ajiye kwalbar ruwa mai tsabta ta wanke ido a kusa, kamar wannan.
Yanzu ki bi darussan da ke ƙasa. Ki shirya rajistar kayan aikinki, ki gwada pH na kaya biyar a gida, ki kuma shirya kusurwarki mai tsabta.
